:::{#exm-distributive}
#### Distributing "and" over "or"
<!-- no-figure: a rewording of one sentence; nothing to plot -->

Let $n$ be an [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers).
"$n$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd), and $n > 0$ or $n < 0$"
has the form $A \land (B \lor C)$.
By the first [distributive law](#thm-distributive),
it says the same thing as
"$n$ is even and $n > 0$, or $n$ is even and $n < 0$",
which has the form $(A \land B) \lor (A \land C)$.

:::
